name: com.midmanstudio.questly
description: Game-agnostic quest engine on top of the DixScript (.mdix) database: declarative objectives/prereqs/rewards, an automatic unlock watcher plus manual override, push-based progress reporting, and a pluggable evaluator hook for game-specific objective/prereq types. Zero game-specific logic — a consuming game layers its own interpretation on top, the same relationship it has with com.midmanstudio.alembic.
